latest.summary: Debt segment continue to face marginal reduction in quarterly average AUM at INR11.60 lakh crores. For H1 FY 2027, our margins on an annualized basis stands at 67 basis points for equity, 32 basis points for debt, 12 basis points for liquid, 12 basis points for passives, and 29 basis points for arbitrage. Additionally, the Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of INR30 per share.
highlights: Debt segment continue to face marginal reduction in quarterly average AUM at INR11.60 lakh crores.

For H1 FY 2027, our margins on an annualized basis stands at 67 basis points for equity, 32 basis points for debt, 12 basis points for liquid, 12 basis points for passives, and 29 basis points for arbitrage.
Additionally, the Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of INR30 per share.
For H1 FY27, our operating margins on an annualized basis stood at 37.3 basis point as compared to 36.6 basis point for H1 of FY26.
The industry's quarterly average AUM grew by 13.4% year-on-year and 5.1% sequentially in Q2 FY 2027, reaching to INR87.49 lakh crores.

strengths: In active schemes, we continue to maintain the highest market share of 13.3% with a quarterly average AUM of INR9.59 lakh crores.
